incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout shows its own error spans in the last 5 minutes: increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) is 2.5000104167100696 for service_name=checkout, span_name=oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, while the same operation's STATUS_CODE_UNSET series is 2.5000104167100696, so both happy and failing PlaceOrder spans exist.

Two failing checkout traces in the window are df7f982604009dae0e2cbd5920cbd818 and c9ca3e69ba1d9a81373a51a102a777dd; in both, checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (span ids 4ce2032d75b73a09 and d73e814a21507d8c) carries error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 with status description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and durations 40013 us and 25805 us.

Checkout's outbound span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is the failing dependency edge: in traces df7f982604009dae0e2cbd5920cbd818 and c9ca3e69ba1d9a81373a51a102a777dd its client spans (fba7b26e8ce33eb2 and e09f8276b7fed5b0) have error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and status description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', lasting only 16100 us and 9045 us. Aggregated, checkout's rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count has rpc_service=oteldemo.PaymentService, rpc_method=Charge with rpc_grpc_status_code=2 increase 1.250010416753473 in the window.

The deepest visible failing component is the payment service's own charge handler: payment's span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span ids edbe3cfe26ed4ec4 and d558ae824544ef5c, trace ids df7f982604009dae0e2cbd5920cbd818 and c9ca3e69ba1d9a81373a51a102a777dd) has error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and exception message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with stack trace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'. Within the same failing charge span, payment's flag lookup grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (span af26403eaa6f4ab2) returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in 5337 us.

The failure is partial, not a total outage: the sampled payment trace f0680f5af1d5c7cb0261a0fb9c569fd3 (start_us 1793708651527292) contains checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 6625a84d17efc2fc with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span 1c1cef344fe5d84e with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, payment's span 21ab0cc4518d7099 with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and email POST /send_order_confirmation span 59b09b7f9fcfbeb3 with http.status_code=200.

The error burst is recent and sustained: increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is 0 at evaluation times 1793707288 (12:01:28Z), 1793707588 (12:06:28Z) and 1793707888 (12:11:28Z), then 5.000020833420139 at 1793708188 (12:16:28Z), 5.000020833420139 at 1793708488 (12:21:28Z) and 2.5000104167100696 at 1793708788 (12:26:28Z). These are extrapolated 5-minute increase values, not exact span counts.

No latency elevation is visible for checkout's outbound calls. Equal-length comparison of average rpc_client_duration_milliseconds (sum divided by count) for service_name=checkout, incident window 12:21:28Z-12:26:28Z versus baseline 12:11:28Z-12:16:28Z: oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 12.411098333332424 ms versus 19.053650500000003 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 9.485079666667541 ms versus 9.893457999998645 ms, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 2.758752666666927 ms versus 3.2469380000002275 ms, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 1.3225746666666964 ms versus 0.9113133333333584 ms, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 3.1621708333326146 ms versus 1.8628132000005282 ms; EmptyCart (4.434307999999874 ms) and ShipOrder (0.4367020000000821 ms) had no baseline samples (NaN).

Checkout's other dependencies show no failures in the window. The cluster-wide STATUS_CODE_ERROR aggregation returned error series for checkout, payment, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator and recommendation only, plus a cart series 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart' with value 0; no ERROR series was returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email. In the sampled traces those calls succeeded: checkout oteldemo.CartService/GetCart rpc.grpc.status_code=0, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert rpc.grpc.status_code=0, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct rpc.grpc.status_code=0, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with shipping span http.status_code=200, and email POST /send_order_confirmation http.status_code=200.

Dependency server-side durations observed in the sample are small: product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 67-713 us, currency Currency/Convert 385-1757 us with otel.status_code=OK, cart HGET 227-2208 us and POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 331-2366 us, shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 5201-9804 us, and email send_email 13470 us.

The errors propagate to callers along the same traces: frontend spans grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (bfe3f8b3705db041 and e973ab0780f7746e) have error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 with grpc.error_message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; frontend POST /api/checkout, frontend POST, frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress, and load-generator POST all carry http.status_code 500 and error=true in traces df7f982604009dae0e2cbd5920cbd818 and c9ca3e69ba1d9a81373a51a102a777dd.

Only ad, checkout and product-catalog appear as service_name values on rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count in this window, so a payment server-side latency series under service_name=payment was not available in that metric family.

The proximate cause of the checkout error burst is payment's charge handler rejecting the charge request as an invalid token at charge.js:37 (payment's own span and exception are the terminal error in both failing traces), so checkout's PlaceOrder failures are a downstream consequence of that rejection rather than an independent checkout fault. The failing charge spans contain a successful flagd ResolveFloat child, so the rejection was produced by payment's charge logic after or independently of a successful flag evaluation; the returned flag value and the request token/card data are not visible, so whether the token was caller-supplied-invalid or rejected by payment-side validation or flag behaviour remains unresolved.

Elevated latency or timeouts as the cause of checkout's errors is rejected: failing Charge calls return in 9045-16100 us, the two failing PlaceOrder spans last 25805 and 40013 us (a successful PlaceOrder in the same period lasted 67025 us), and checkout's average outbound durations in the incident window are equal to or lower than the immediately preceding baseline window for every dependency that has baseline samples.

Failures in cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping or email explaining checkout's errors are rejected: in the window no ERROR-status span series was returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email, cart's only error series ('POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart') was 0, and every sampled checkout call to those services returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with HTTP 200 where applicable; the only failing edge in the traces is oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge.

gaps: Why payment reports an invalid token is not established: no span attributes or logs show the charge request's card/token value, there is no payment-side validation output beyond the charge.js:37 exception, and the float returned by payment's flagd ResolveFloat child span is not visible.

Pod logs, Kubernetes state and change history are not integrated in this Run, so no deployment or configuration change can be correlated with the error onset between the windows ending 12:11:28Z and 12:16:28Z.

Payment does not expose rpc_server_duration_milliseconds under service_name=payment (only ad, checkout and product-catalog appear); the two payment server-duration queries returned status no_data (evidence ids 867e2ffd-04a5-4f4b-a9e0-1bf0bdc14c5b-t2:7db6027f-f203-4c1e-a71a-e2c3478bc509 and 867e2ffd-04a5-4f4b-a9e0-1bf0bdc14c5b-t3:a91e9080-3452-4a49-a655-b724fb188a2b), so payment's own server-side latency was not measured.

Exact error rates and request counts are unknown: traces_search returns a sampled view and the reported error values are extrapolated 5-minute increase() values, not counts of requests or unique failures.

The trace view used for payment evidence (fb218332-4be6-460a-8dce-6486d967ada4-t0:934fadf5-de2c-45ea-b4ed-6f65bbb50c04) is flagged incomplete because the backend returned as many traces as requested, so more failing or healthy traces may exist beyond the three sampled.

The metric-name listing view 8974cab9-2ea3-46cc-89ea-9e969e3033ec-t1:96f517c2-3c24-4523-90ce-ba3068261206 was incomplete (100-value limit reached), so the available latency metric names are not fully enumerated.

An ERROR series for service_name=recommendation, span_name=/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (increase 1.2500052083550348) also appears in the window; recommendation is not one of checkout's dependency calls and no evidence ties it to this failure, so it was not investigated and is recorded as unexplained rather than impact of this cause.
Whether payment failures affect callers other than checkout cannot be determined from the sampled traces; no other caller of PaymentService/Charge is visible in this evidence.

report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T12:21:28Z-12:26:28Z) checkout does show elevated errors, and they are confined to the payment charge edge of PlaceOrder. Two failing traces (df7f982604009dae0e2cbd5920cbd818 and c9ca3e69ba1d9a81373a51a102a777dd) show checkout's server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13 whose status description is 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with error=true and the same 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' exception thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37. The rejection is generated inside payment's charge handler, not by transport; failing Charge calls return in 9045-16100 us and failing PlaceOrder spans in 25805-40013 us. Checkout's other dependency calls show no ERROR spans and no elevated latency: cart GetCart/EmptyCart, product-catalog GetProduct, currency Convert, shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder (HTTP 200) and email POST /send_order_confirmation (HTTP 200) all returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 or HTTP 200 in the sampled traces, and checkout's average outbound durations in the incident window are at or below an equal-length baseline window immediately before it (Charge 12.41 ms vs 19.05 ms, GetQuote 9.49 ms vs 9.89 ms). Failure is partial, not total: one sampled trace (f0680f5af1d5c7cb0261a0fb9c569fd3) completed the same path with payment Charge rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and email 200. Error series for checkout PlaceOrder and payment Charge were zero at 12:01:28Z, 12:06:28Z and 12:11:28Z and nonzero from the window ending 12:16:28Z, so the burst began roughly 10-15 minutes before the query end. Why payment judges the token invalid (caller-supplied card data versus payment-side validation or flag-driven behaviour) is not determinable from the available signals.
